text:
Maya: Quick experiment plan — running a sensitivity sweep across FP8 / INT8 / AWQ / GPTQ on new-llm-13b. Main question: how does prefix-KV cache + continuous batching affect output quality (perplexity / exact-match) and latency? Thinking to vary: cache TTL, batch max tokens, continuous-batching window, quant scheme. Anyone seen weird staleness/degeneration with AWQ + prefetch?

Liam: Saw something last week — AWQ had ~0.9% EM drop when prefix cache was stale and cont-batch merged different seq lengths. Might be a KV-alignment bug; logs showed unexpected kv_mismatch_count increments.

Gabi: Can we reproduce deterministically? I only saw drift when prefetch enabled + cont-batch window >= 50ms. Short windows looked fine.

PerfBot: perf-summary: ran quick microbench (5k requests) — AWQ vs FP8 vs INT8: tokens/sec +40% (AWQ), p50 latency -35% (AWQ) but rouge-L delta -0.6 for AWQ in this pass.

Maya: Example config I'll start with tonight:
```yaml
model: new-llm-13b-awq
quant: awq-int8
batching:
  continuous_window_ms: 75
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
prefetch:
  kv_cache_ttl_ms: 120000
  enabled: true
rollout: canary: 10%
```

Tara: Suggest full matrix: prefetch on/off; continuous_window_ms = [0,25,75,150]; kv_ttl = [30s,2m,5m]; quant = [fp8,int8,awq,gptq]. Use deterministic 200-prompt eval set (short + long-prefix buckets). I'll queue runs on infra.

Liam: Also capture metrics: prefix_hit_rate, kv_mismatch_count, per-request prefix_len, p50/p95 latency, and exact_match / perplexity per-bucket. Add regression alert if EM drop > 1.5% vs fp8 baseline.

Gabi: One more: track per-token bias drift on long prefixes (>512). I saw hallucination growth with AWQ when prefix was >1k tokens and cont-batch combined it with short queries.

Maya: Good call. If we reproduce, we can try two mitigations: 1) make prefetch TTL adaptive by prefix-length, 2) disable AWQ on requests with prefix_len > 512 via routing policy.

PerfBot: initial-sweep posted: https://redwood/internal/runs/1977777777 — summary: AWQ + prefetch + cont_window=75 -> p50 28ms (baseline fp8 42ms), EM -1.1%; INT8 + prefetch -> p50 31ms, EM -0.4%; AWQ with cont_window=150 increased kv_mismatch_count x3 and EM -1.8%.

Maya: Filed infra issue for KV alignment investigation: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/8344 — tagging @eng-runtime. I'll paste logs from the failing run later. :thumbsup:
